dyad-provider-interface-01.packet: Declare and implement the narrow DYAD provider interface (objective Part 8): a review request carries task/attempt identity, physical/programming context, the claim under examination, non-leading observation questions, ordered capture references with hashes, camera/runtime metadata, requested review type (still|ordered_frames|movie) and explicit evidence limits. A response retains served provider/model identity where available, input capture identities, the exact prompt, raw response, completion/finish status, observations with uncertainty, and a structured verdict under existing acceptance rules. Providers declare temporal capability; a still-only provider refuses temporal claims by name; no-vision and missing/corrupt-capture (hash mismatch) refuse fail-closed; numeric mentions in visual text are tagged unverified, never manufactured into facts. Adapter kinds: subagent callback, remote HTTP config, local senses/LM Studio path (retained, not replaced). STATEMENT: the interface separates the review CONTRACT from the vision PROVIDER so a dedicated reviewer can run via subagent, remote service or the existing local eye without protocol change. PREDICTION: synthetic provider tests show fail-closed refusals (no_vision, capture_missing, capture_hash_mismatch, provider_cannot_verify_temporal_claim), full evidence retention including exact prompt and raw response, verdict parsing that never emits numeric facts from visual text, and provider selection by configuration. FALSIFIER: a temporal claim accepted from a still-only provider, a numeric fact asserted from a visual response, a missing/corrupt capture passed through, prompt or raw response not retained, or the local adapter removed/bypassed. CPU synthetic tests only; actual visual acceptance stays NOT_CLAIMED until a live provider run with retained evidence.

STATEMENT: a pre-commit guard WARNS (does not block) when files under docs/evidence/ are ignored-and-untracked while sibling evidence in the same commit cites evidence files, or more simply: warn when any staged add under docs/evidence/ coexists with ignored *.log files in the same directory. PREDICTION: a deterministic hook script + test detects the trap case (staged evidence + ignored .log sibling) and is silent on clean cases; the hook is wired per the repo's existing hook conventions WITHOUT weakening any existing hook. FALSIFIER: the trap case passes silently; a clean case warns; any existing gate/hook weakened or bypassed; or blocking behavior added where warning was specified. F2 (leaked fixture child, feedback 5cfa9382): the capture suite's foreign-process fixture child (message-pump python) survived its parent and held a directory busy. STATEMENT: the fixture child exits when its parent dies (watchdog in the child: poll parent pid or an OS job object), so no fixture can outlive its test run. PREDICTION: a test kills the parent (or simulates orphaning) and the child exits within the guard window; normal fixture behavior unchanged; capture suite + full fleet suite green. FALSIFIER: an orphaned fixture surviving the guard window in the test; existing capture behavior changed; gates weakened. Scopes: tools/agent_fleet/capture_window.py, tools/agent_fleet/test_capture_window.py, the hook script location per repo convention (inspect first), docs/evidence/agent_fleet/EVIDENCE_HYGIENE. The test asserts lock_errors==0 on a 20s 8-thread SQLite churn on a SHARED host — an environmental assertion the fleet has now outgrown (10+ concurrent lanes). DELIVERABLE: derive, do not sweep — RULE 1: state WHAT QUESTION the tolerance answers. The lock_errors==0 assertion guards against REGRESSIONS in the single-writer discipline (BEGIN IMMEDIATE correctness), not against host contention delays; a lock error under externally-induced contention is a different failure class than a regression. Options to DERIVE from that distinction (pick with justification, preregister): (a) move the zero-lock-errors assertion to an ISOLATED registry + isolated subprocess run (no shared-state coupling) while keeping latency percentiles in-suite with load-aware bounds; (b) a bounded retry with retained first-failure record (the capture-flake-tolerance-01 pattern — verdict-exact trigger, structural max-1, drift raises); (c) a measured contention budget with a declared ceiling. Whatever is chosen: the assertion must still FAIL against a real single-writer regression (mutation probe: break the transaction discipline in a COPY — the test must catch it). PREDICTION: after the change, N consecutive full-suite runs under live fleet load stay green AND the mutation probe still fires. FALSIFIER: any run flapping under load, or the regression mutation passing. Evidence *.txt with all runs retained. Trailer Agent: <your session>.

product-feel-probe-01.packet: PRODUCT-FEEL PROBE (operator-directed 2026-09-11: 'the cards encompass all the fancy physics; we still have to create a product for humans'). Evidence-scoped probe, NOT a card claim - the demo-lane precedent (membrane_window_demo, gpu-demo records). THE QUESTION: is the EXISTING physics already human-legible? THE PROBE: script one interaction with the current teddy (the PR #79 families - joints n_joints==19, strain, or water), e.g. a perturbation-and-response sequence; render the rotation/response movie via ChimeraEngine/cpp_bridge.py render_teddy_movie; encode (encode_movie -> MP4); judge with the DYAD loop per tools/dyad_subagent_template.py (vision subagent, GLM 5.3 Flash, blind to implementation details - declare in the spec exactly what the judge may see). STATEMENT: the existing families already produce a movie from which an independent vision judge can identify the physics behavior class AND state what a human watching it would learn. PREDICTION: the blind judge names the behavior (e.g. soft-body deformation with restoring force) and articulates the lesson in one sentence a non-physicist understands. FALSIFIER: the judge cannot identify the behavior, or names none, or the lesson is unintelligible to a lay reader - the probe FAILS and the product is honestly recorded as not-yet-human-legible (that negative is the deliverable then). Acceptance NOT_CLAIMED beyond the measured verdict. RULE 0 prereg first (declare the interaction, the movie plan, the judge spec, and the acceptance rubric BEFORE rendering). Acquire rtx4090 + engine_demo through your session before any engine run; release with drain evidence after. NEVER touch ChimeraEngine/engine/build/ or the operator checkout.
